description: An EXTENSION D_PDU addressed to this node draws WARNING reason 4 (unrecognised extended type); one addressed to broadcast draws nothing.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000, from 0.0.1.3, EOW 0, EOT 10 (end 7000): an EXTENSION (type 13, extended type 1, a WTRP type, no extended header bytes) to the broadcast address 15.255.255.255, address size 7; then an EXTENSION (extended type 0x42) to 0.0.1.2, address size 4. No extended type is implemented, so both are unrecognised (C-0735). Only the one to this node's individual address draws a WARNING: RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 13, reason 4 (C-0392, J-0052; coordinator ruling on C-0735 and J-0053). An EXTENSION has no GROUP ADDRESS bit, so for the two-node rule the one to 15.255.255.255 is directly addressed to another node and condition (a) fails (K-0068, K-0072). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000 ms; at 7000 the idle is VDCD-determined and rule 3 gives csma.lbt_wait 3000 ms (K-0071); at 10000 CONT_WAIT, slot 15, 45000 ms; at 55000 the WARNING goes out: type 15, address size 3 (C-0133), 0.0.1.2 to 0.0.1.3, EOW 0, EOT 10 (one block, duration 5550). Since corpus 0.18.0 the channel analysis also reports the WTRP D_PDU (extended type 1) at the burst end: S_MANAGEMENT_MSG_INDICATION to conn 1, MSG TYPE 1, finding 1 (WTRP in use) for 0.0.1.3, addressee 0 (J-0051, J-0082, J-0083); the extended type 0x42 is not a WTRP type and adds nothing.
